_comment: The repo-level ruleset workflow 752 adds to an FFC-EX repo that has no merge queue on its default branch. GitHub cannot put a merge queue in an organization ruleset, so it is per repo. Copied from the ruleset 44 FFC-EX repos already carried on 2026-10-12 (for example FFC-EX-3dmc2.org ruleset 19098640), field for field. merge_method MERGE needs the repo to allow merge commits; 752 checks that before applying. Bypass: the repository Admin role (id 5), as on those repos.
